No. 2144/26 – WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 09, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
Notice under Section 7
of the Land Acquisition Act

My No.:-5/3/5/1/43. Reference No. of Ministry of Land and Parliamentary Affairs:- 4-3/10/2013/UDA/79. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No 28 of 1964. That the government intends to acquire the following Land /Servitude which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Allotments of land in extent of 0.4614 Hectares depicted in Lot Nos.1-18 (18 Lots) in the Preliminary Plan No. Ma/1762 of Surveyor General dated 21.01.2019, situated in Dambulla Town in Division No.06 (Within Municipal Limits of Dambulla) in Dambulla Town Grama Niladhari Division (E445), in Wagapanahapallesiya Pattuwa Small Division in Dambulla Divisional Secretariat in Matale District in Central Province.
1. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Hitinawatta, Kandurugahamulayaya; Description of land: Compound; There is a mixed crop

cultivation around 10-15 years old and a foundation. Claimed by: State; Originally claimed by Rangiri Dambulu Rajamaha Viharaya, enjoyed by V. M. Dayananda of Dambulla Matale road; Extent:0.0654 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands/servitudes to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Dambulla Divisional Secretariat on 21.11.2019 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicates) on or before

14.11.2019 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/land servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. H. P. P. A. HEWAPATHIRANA, Divisional Secretary, Dambulla.
